draft.subject: Your CSV export ticket + next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for flagging the CSV export missing its last column -- your ticket is open and I'm staying on it until we have an answer for you.

In the meantime, you've got your first project up, and projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, with tasks living inside them. If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to walk through how your team is structuring things and make sure nothing's blocking you.

Just reply with a couple of times that suit and I'll work around them.

Best,
Nadia
